# Cullum & Co

> Cullum & Co is Scott Cullum's creative technology practice, helping teams cut through ambiguity and move the work forward across design, engineering, and product.

Most engagements bring Scott in part-time for senior direction and hands-on support. A small network of trusted collaborators joins when the work needs additional depth. The practice uses AI-native tools for faster exploration and fewer wasted cycles.

## How we help

- Fractional advisory for product and technology leaders
- AI-native exploration and prototyping
- Capability support for teams adopting modern workflows
- Technical direction across front-end architecture and experience quality
- Flexible team support through trusted collaborators

## Pages

- [About Cullum & Co](https://cullum.co/about): the practice, Scott's biography, and his career experience
- [Services](https://cullum.co/services): engagement models and offerings
- [Work](https://cullum.co/work): Cullum & Co projects alongside Scott's work at World Wide Technology and AKQA; case studies retain their original organization and his account of his contribution
